injuries.detail: Powell (shoulder) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the 76ers, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.
Collins (illness) is out for Sunday's game against Philadelphia.
Bona (back) is out for Sunday's game in Chicago.
Head coach Nick Nurse said Wednesday that Barlow (back) likely needs another 10-12 days before he's cleared to return to the court, Derek Bodner of AllPHLY.com
Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
